name: Rock
description: Overdriven and distorted guitars on a riff, a picked bass, power chords, the kick and snare square on the beat, the hi-hat in 8ths, minor or Mixolydian, mid to fast.

name: Jazz
description: Swung, the ride keeping time on a jazz or brush kit, a sparse kick, an upright bass walking in quarters, sevenths, ninths and shells, piano and jazz guitar comping off the beat, sax and trumpet leads, solos likely.

name: Dark jazz
description: Slow, dark jazz, a noir lounge band at a funeral's pace: a tenor sax or a vibraphone holding long notes over an electric piano's held minor chords, an upright bass on the roots, brushes barely there, an organ, strings or a choir beneath, minutes on two or three chords, everything soft and in a hall, 40 to 76.

name: House
description: The kick four on the floor, the hi-hat on the offbeats, everything repeating, synth leads, a pumping bass and pads, piano and electric piano chords now and then, a TR-808 or electronic kit, straight or its 16ths lightly swung, 118 to 128, minor and Dorian, minor sevenths and ninths, piano, organ and Rhodes stabs, a shaker in 16ths, a drop into the chorus.

name: Techno
description: A kick on every beat, driving and dark, the hi-hat on the offbeats, one figure looping for minutes over a chord or two, a square or sawtooth riff, little melody, a minor or Phrygian key, a TR-808 or electronic kit, 130 to 145, the pads and bass pumping.

name: Synthwave
description: Eighties synths over a big backbeat, the snare on 2 and 4, sawtooth leads, polysynth pads and strings, a synth bass in eighths, a verse and a chorus, major or minor, 85 to 118, a lead's echo and a pad's chorus.

name: Hip-hop
description: Slow, lightly swung 16ths on a TR-808, a sparse syncopated kick, a repeating bass, electric piano, piano and pads looping, minor and Dorian, now and then a darker Phrygian or harmonic minor loop.

name: Reggae
description: Slow, the one drop with the kick and snare on beat 3, the chords and a rhythm guitar skanking on the offbeats, a sparse repeating bass, organ, major and minor.

name: Dub
description: Reggae taken apart at the desk: the riddim's drums and bass carrying long stretches alone, the voice and the horns in fragments, echo and a spring reverb leading, the filter sweeping, one riddim looped the whole track, the steppers' kick now and then.

name: Latin
description: The kit and percussion, congas, bongos, claves, cowbell, timbales and a guiro, a time keeper in the tresillo's 3+3+2, the bass anticipating the beat, nylon guitar, piano and trumpet, minor and Dorian, fast.

name: Funk
description: The hi-hat in 16ths, a busy syncopated slap or finger bass, a clavinet and a muted guitar comping in 16ths, brass, sevenths and ninths, Dorian and Mixolydian, everything repeating.

name: Funk rock
description: Funk's slap bass, 16th hats, ghost notes and a muted 16th guitar, with an overdriven guitar riff and choruses opening into big distorted chords, sevenths, 7♯9 and power chords, Dorian and Mixolydian, no horns nor keys, the power kit, 88 to 110.

name: Jazz-funk
description: Funk's groove played softer and jazzier: sevenths, ninths and elevenths, mediants and ii–V passing chords, an electric piano and warm pads, a finger bass leading, a flute or a soft lead, a laid-back pocket, 75 to 100, 4/4, short sung forms, few solos.

name: Folk
description: Steel and nylon guitars strummed, a fiddle, a banjo, a harmonica, an acoustic bass, plain triads, major and Mixolydian, 3/4 and 6/8 as likely as not, a tambourine and a shaker on a room kit.

name: Celtic
description: Irish and Scottish tunes: a fiddle, a flute or a whistle and the pipes playing jigs and reels in unison, a bouzouki or a guitar droning beneath, Dorian and Mixolydian, cuts and rolls, sets of tunes changing key, a bodhrán or no drums, 100 to 190.

name: Blues
description: A shuffle, sevenths over Mixolydian, a harmonica, an overdriven guitar and an organ, slow to mid.

name: Ambient
description: Slow, pads, strings, a choir, a harp and a celesta, chords held long, sus and add9 chords, Lydian and major, the drums rare and sparse.

name: Pop
description: A verse, a pre-chorus and a chorus on a hook, the last chorus now and then lifted a key or played twice, piano, synths and clean guitars, the kick and snare on the beat, plain triads and add9 chords, mostly major, 95 to 125.

name: Power ballad
description: Slow, 60 to 95, mostly in 4/4, now and then 12/8: a clean or acoustic guitar's broken chords let ring with sweet held tones, an overdriven lead singing the melody, a fingered bass and strings, sus2 and add9 chords, the band building section by section in a big room, a heavy chorus, a guitar solo, now and then the last chorus up a step, fading or ringing out.

name: Lyrical guitar
description: Mellow, melancholic instrumental guitar: a dry jazz or nylon guitar's repeating melody over acoustic guitars' broken chords let ring, a simple bass, a heavy delay, a steady downtempo beat or none, a cello now and then, natural minor and Dorian with a Spanish colour, a distorted solo building at the end now and then, 76 to 95.

name: Heavy metal
description: Distorted twin guitars on a galloping riff in power chords, the snare on 2 and 4, harmonised solos, natural and harmonic minor, the chords climbing ♭VI–♭VII–i, mid to fast.

name: Thrash metal
description: Fast and tight: palm-muted 16ths chugging on the low string, the kick and the bass locked with the riff, a double kick, long stretches on one chord, Phrygian and chromatic riffs, a half-time break, wild whammy solos.

name: Symphonic metal
description: Distorted guitars and a double kick under a choir, strings and a church organ, a soaring melody on a violin or a voice-like lead, harmonic minor's raised cadence, keyboard and guitar solos, a lifted last chorus.

name: Doom metal
description: Slow and crushing: low power chords held and left to ring over a heavy, sparse beat, long stretches on one chord creeping by half steps, the tritone and Phrygian, an organ, a mournful lead, few solos, long songs.

name: Medieval
description: Calm and modal: recorders, flutes and a fiddle over a lute and a harp, a choir and a drone, open fifths, a second voice in fourths and fifths, 3/4 and 6/8, slow, a tambourine, a triangle and a frame drum marking the form.

name: Dungeon synth
description: Dark and slow: a harpsichord's ostinato under a celesta or a horn, synth strings, choirs and brass, minor and harmonic minor triads, drones and a deep reverb, a timpani and a snare's roll marking the form.

name: Djent
description: Low distorted guitars chugging a cycle of 16ths across the bar, the kick with them, the snare on 3 and a china in quarters against it, one chord or none, Phrygian and Locrian, now and then a clean lead floating over.

name: Nu metal
description: A low distorted riff of one note chugged in a syncopated hip-hop groove, the kick and the bass with it, a picked or clicking slap bass, quiet clean verses with room for a voice and loud distorted choruses, squealing bends, natural minor and Phrygian.

name: Disco
description: The kick four on the floor, the open hi-hat off the beat, a bass in octaves, strings and horns, a clean guitar scratching 16ths, electric piano sevenths and ninths, minor and Dorian, 110 to 130.

name: Trap
description: A TR-808 in half time, the hi-hat in 16ths rolling into 32nds and triplets, a long gliding bass, dark bells and pads looping, minor and Phrygian, verses left to a voice.

name: Trance
description: The kick four on the floor, the hi-hat off the beat, sawtooth arpeggios and leads over pumping pads, a rolling bass, minor, 132 to 140, long sections building to a drop.

name: Psytrance
description: Goa and full-on: a rolling bass, kick then three notes, under a one-chord vamp, Phrygian dominant, acid lines squelching, 16th sequenced riffs calling and answering, few pads, 140 to 148, six to nine minutes.

name: Drum and bass
description: Liquid: breakbeats at 165 to 178, a syncopated kick and the snare on 2 and 4, the hi-hat in 16ths, a deep synth bass, electric piano, piano and pads in minor sevenths, moody rather than bright, long sections and drops.

name: Ska
description: Fast, the guitar and the piano skanking on the offbeats, a walking bass, horns on a riff and in solos, trumpet and sax leads, major, Mixolydian or minor.

name: Punk
description: Fast and short, distorted power chords strummed in 8ths, a picked bass driving 8ths, the drums straight and loud, major, Mixolydian or minor, a count-in and a stop.

name: Fusion
description: Electric piano and a soprano sax over a fretless bass singing high, Lydian, Dorian and melodic minor, ninths to thirteenths and quartal chords, chords in scales of their own and planed, odd meters, long solos.

name: Soul
description: An organ, a piano and horns, sevenths and ninths passing through applied dominants, a laid-back backbeat, 4/4 or a swaying 6/8, a last chorus lifted, sax solos answering the tune.

name: Country
description: A fiddle, a steel-string guitar strummed, a banjo and a honky-tonk piano, plain triads moving by fourths and fifths, the bass on the root and the fifth, the snare on 2 and 4, major and Mixolydian.

name: Bluegrass
description: Bill Monroe's high lonesome sound: no drums, a banjo rolling, a mandolin's chop on 2 and 4, a guitar's runs and a fiddle, an upright bass on the root and the fifth, breaks passed round the band, tenor harmony, played ahead of the beat, 110 to 180.

name: Bossa nova
description: A nylon guitar's syncopated chords, a flute or a sax, major sevenths and ninths moving by ii-V, the snare's cross-stick on a brush kit, a shaker, soft and straight, 100 to 140.

name: Orchestral
description: Strings, horns and woodwinds over a contrabass, a harp's arpeggios, timpani and a cymbal marking the form, minor, major and harmonic minor, long crescendos into louder sections, parts entering one by one.

name: Cinematic piano
description: A film's piano: a piano melody over a piano's arpeggios two octaves wide, strings swelling under it, a bass stepping down through the chords, add9, sus and seventh chords, major, minor and Lydian, AABA with a big return and the last section lifted a key, no drums, 60 to 90, or a bouncy 150.

name: Chamber
description: Chamber music: a melody on violin, flute or clarinet over a piano's Alberti figure and a cello's bass, no drums, raised cadences and ornaments, phrases of four bars, AABA, ABA and a rondo, terraced dynamics, 80 to 140 in 4/4, 3/4 and 6/8.

name: Black metal
description: Fast, cold and raw: tremolo-picked minor riffs over blast beats and a double kick, triads rather than power chords, a choir or synth strings behind, natural minor, Phrygian and harmonic minor, long repeating sections, a deep reverb, few solos.

name: IDM
description: Warm and warped at its plainest, a slow swung breakbeat under detuned pads, an electric piano and a music box, sevenths and Dorian; wilder, an acid bass squelching and gliding, odd meters, tuplets and polymeters, and drums splintering into rolls.

name: 16-bit game
description: A Mega Drive's FM chip: a slap or synth bass in busy 16ths, a DX electric piano and FM brass, sevenths and sus chords, sampled drums and orchestra hits, a bright lead echoed on a second channel, a game loop fading out, 110 to 160.

name: Chiptune
description: Square and saw waves on every part, as an old games console's sound chip plays them: chords broken into fast arpeggios, a pulse bass, a catchy hook repeated, a small electronic kit, straight, 110 to 190, a game loop or a few minutes long, major or minor.
